title: viola minuta subsp. dagestanica
intro: Viola minuta subsp. dagestanica, commonly known as Dagestanian violet, is a plant species in the violet genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help in the management of various health conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Viola minuta subsp. dagestanica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. These bioactive compounds may contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic effects, making it a subject of interest in the field of phytomedicine.
